# Manchester and Liverpool Beer Trip 2026

> Source-backed wiki for two experienced beer travellers on a five-day November 2026 trip. Priorities: real ale, real cider/perry, traditional and spectacular pubs, worthwhile food. Read uncertainty notes before recommending a visit.

Research date: 2026-10-28. Venue count: 158. Relative links resolve from this repository root. Do not infer current stock, opening or reservations from this snapshot.

## Start here

- [README](README.md): navigation and trip priorities.
- [Wiki index](wiki/index.md): topic map.
- [Methodology](wiki/methodology.md): scope, evidence hierarchy and limitations.
- [Cider guide](wiki/real-cider.md): evidence states and product qualification.
- [Shortlists](wiki/shortlists.md): strongest matches by interest.
- [Five-day plan](wiki/five-day-plan.md): modular route with substitutions.
- [Excursions](wiki/excursions.md): time and interest tradeoffs.
- [November events](wiki/november-events.md): advertised 2026 opportunities.
- [Logistics](wiki/logistics.md): confirmed November transport cautions.
- [Changes and exclusions](wiki/changes-and-exclusions.md): closures and conflicting evidence.
- [Research log](wiki/log.md): material changes and follow-up work.
